Sampling explained

SAME MOTION / DIFFERENT DETAIL

48 kHz records more. The model expects 12 kHz.

Model input
Why not upload 48 kHz directly?

The feature values would describe a different frequency range and time scale than the model learned. More samples are not automatically better when the deployed model was trained on unified 12 kHz signals.

01

12 kHz

Resample first if the recorder uses another rate.

02

≥ 2,048 values

Each complete block becomes one analysis window.

03

Numbers only

No header, timestamps, units, or second channel.

04

Exact blocks help

Incomplete values after the last full window are ignored.

Inside every 2,048-sample window

0.1707 SECONDS

The model never sees the file name or operating label.

01

Time statistics

RMS, standard deviation, peak, peak-to-peak, skewness and kurtosis.

02

Impact ratios

Crest, shape, impulse and margin factors describe impulsiveness.

03

Spectrum

Hann-windowed FFT yields peak frequency, centroid, spread, entropy and kurtosis.

04

Eight bands

Energy from 0–6 kHz is divided into eight regions.

25 FEATURES

250 trees vote

One forest decides Healthy/Faulty. Another chooses Normal, Inner Race, Ball or Outer Race.

What the result means

Evidence,
not certification.

Confidence is the average tree probability across all complete windows.

Health Index is 100 × Healthy probability. It is not remaining useful life.

Field use requires validation on the actual machine, sensor mounting, load and naturally occurring faults.
